value_sql: CASE WHEN has_transactions = 1 AND n_tx > 0 THEN 100.0 * tx_success_rate END

description: Gross spend percentile within month and currency
value_sql: CASE WHEN has_transactions = 1 AND spend_pctile IS NOT NULL THEN 100.0 * spend_pctile END

description: Spend vs own prior-3-month average (50 = stable)
value_sql: CASE WHEN spend_change_vs_base IS NOT NULL THEN 50 + 50 * greatest(-1, least(1, spend_change_vs_base)) END
CASE WHEN has_engagements = 1 THEN 100.0 * eng_pctile END
CASE WHEN positive_engagement_share IS NOT NULL THEN 100.0 * positive_engagement_share END

description: Engagement vs own prior-3-month average (50 = stable)
value_sql: CASE WHEN eng_change_vs_base IS NOT NULL THEN 50 + 50 * greatest(-1, least(1, eng_change_vs_base)) END
CASE WHEN int_count > 0 THEN 100.0 * (1 - 0.5 * complaint_rate - 0.5 * unresolved_rate) END
CASE WHEN csat_available = 1 THEN csat_health_score END
